name: Garlicky Green Beans with Almonds
description: Quick, bright green beans tossed with golden garlic and toasted flaked almonds. Goes with almost anything.

recipeInstructions.text: Blanch the beans in boiling salted water for 3–4 minutes, then drain.
Meanwhile, toast the almonds in a dry frying pan until golden and tip onto a plate.
Melt the butter in the pan, fry the garlic for 1 minute until just golden, then toss in the beans, almonds and lemon juice. Season and serve.
